summary: Added CompleteOutcome and completeTodo to src/todolist.mjs (returns {outcome, todos}; Completed copies the list with the matched todo done, NotFound returns the input list unchanged; never mutates input). Wired 'done <id>' in src/cli.mjs: saves state and prints Completed (exit 0) or prints NotFound without writing (exit 1); missing id prints usage (exit 2). Added tests for QA-001/AC-1, QA-002/AC-2 plus a multi-item case; replaced the 'Completing todos' placeholder in docs/product/todolist.md (docs index shows the updated section at lines 13-27). Verified on this lease: node scripts/verify.mjs passes 10/10; CLI add/done/list round-trip in a scratch dir writes done:true to .todolist.json. AC-1 -> completeTodo Completed test; AC-2 -> completeTodo NotFound test. Note: scripts/qa-run.mjs carries a pre-existing uncommitted edit (matchIndices fix, receipt id encoding) that is outside this Ticket's scope; left untouched and not claimed as a changed path.
